note: Hand-checked expectations for the demo fixture (plan §17 phase 1 exit criterion). Amounts are integer minor units (cents).

base_case.description: Customer keeps $3,000 available: $1,000 buffer plus the $2,000 rent due 2026-10-05. Tuition ($1,200 due 2026-10-01) is a confirmed record and is paid from checking before the CD matures.

pre_maturity_shortfalls.reason: Tuition installment is due before the CD matures; the locked CD cannot fund it.
Shortfall persists until the CD matures on 2026-10-03.

allocation_checks.700001: infeasible: breaches buffer by 1 minor unit on 2026-10-05

reserve_already_includes_obligations.description: Customer states a $3,000 reserve that already includes the $2,000 rent. The engine must not subtract the rent twice.

double_count_if_not_confirmed.description: Same $3,000 buffer without confirmation counts the rent separately: at most $5,000 can be locked.
